description: This Java class provides enumeration handling for different grouping statuses within the group domain in the Apache Fineract project. It defines methods to map status identifiers and enum constants to EnumOptionData objects with descriptive text.

classes.name: GroupingTypeEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class that provides methods to convert grouping status enums to EnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: status(Integer statusId)
methods.description: Converts a status ID to an EnumOptionData, by first mapping it to a GroupingTypeStatus enum.

methods.name: status(GroupingTypeStatus status)
methods.description: Converts a GroupingTypeStatus enum value into an EnumOptionData object with a human-readable label.
